tagline: Phase through dimensions. Drift through the void.
targetAudience: Casual browser gamers looking for quick, engaging arcade experiences they can play instantly without downloads
Web technology enthusiasts and Three.js/WebGL developers interested in browser-based 3D capabilities
Indie game fans who appreciate unique visual aesthetics and procedural generation
Competitive arcade players motivated by global leaderboards and score chasing
Developers and designers seeking inspiration for browser-based 3D projects
coreValueProps: Instant play: zero downloads, zero installs -- open the browser and you're in the void. Works on any modern device.
Procedurally-generated environments: every run is unique. The void reshapes itself, keeping gameplay fresh across hundreds of sessions.
Global competition: Supabase-powered real-time leaderboard lets you compete against players worldwide and track your progression.
pricingModel: Free-to-play. No microtransactions. Serves as a portfolio showcase for Veridux Labs' technical capabilities in 3D web experiences and real-time backend integration. Revenue is indirect through brand awareness and developer portfolio credibility.

competitors.name: Slope
competitors.positioning: Popular browser-based 3D endless runner. Ball rolls down an increasingly difficult slope. Massive player base through school/office play. Simple WebGL graphics, no accounts or leaderboards. Ad-supported. Extremely accessible but technically basic.

competitors.name: HexGL
competitors.positioning: Open-source browser racing game built with Three.js. Futuristic anti-gravity racer on a fixed track. Technical showcase for WebGL capabilities. Single track, no leaderboard integration, no procedural generation. Impressive but limited replayability.

competitors.name: Krunker.io
competitors.positioning: Browser-based first-person shooter with retro/voxel graphics. Massive multiplayer community, custom maps, trading system. Different genre (FPS vs arcade) but competes for browser gaming attention. More complex, longer session times.

differentiators: Procedurally-generated void environments ensure no two runs are identical
Modern tech stack (React Three Fiber + Zustand) demonstrates production-quality browser 3D
Supabase-powered global leaderboard with real-time updates
Unique visual aesthetic (void/dimensional theme) stands out from typical browser games
Built as a showcase of what's possible with modern web technologies
